name: Комбінація (5)
description: Combinations are the most powerful moves in chess. They often involve multiple tactical themes or a sham sacrifice. Sometimes, you must temporarily sacrifice material to ultimately achieve a significant gain. The ultimate goal of a combination is usually to gain material. By recognizing tactical patterns and thinking ahead, you can find sequences of moves that completely surprise your opponent.

examples.text: The d-file is packed with pieces. White can take advantage of this by first exchanging the bishop and then capturing the pawn on c5. This creates a winning pin, allowing White to gain material.
With a clever check, White creates a multi-attack against the black rook.
